candidates.title: City station readings (hourly), Environment Monitoring Unit
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of hourly NO2 and PM2.5 from the city's own stations; can serve the production window if coverage holds. Cannot serve the prototype window.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5'; get_catalog_entry airq.station_readings; wiki station_network
suspected_issues: Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01, so it does not cover the prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 (catalog entry)
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30 but catalog still lists the network as active (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
ts_utc timestamps are good for joins; PM2.5 method changes and validation flags not documented in catalog columns
Access via request to Environment Monitoring Unit; request status unknown (no wiki record found)

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly), Mobility Office
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly vehicle counts near monitoring stations; covers the production window if the counter break is handled.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'traffic counts hourly road sensors'; get_catalog_entry traffic.hourly_counts; wiki counter_replacement_2024
suspected_issues: Counters replaced 2024-03-18; counts were per direction before and both directions combined after (wiki counter_replacement_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02); catalog has no note on this
Timestamps are ts_local (local time), so DST handling needed for join to UTC air data
No sensor coordinates or counter-to-station mapping in catalog columns
Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2021-01-01; owner Mobility Office; licence and outage rate unknown

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district), Clinical Analytics
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregated daily respiratory visit counts by district, the only clinic data permitted under the clinic data policy.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'respiratory clinic visits daily count district'; get_catalog_entry clinic.resp_visits_daily; wiki clinic_data_policy
suspected_issues: Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2022-01-01; covers production window if extract is complete
Small-cell suppression rule and district code system not documented in catalog
Data-sharing basis for the analysis not confirmed in any wiki page read (clinic_data_policy says only daily district counts may be used)
Visit counts reflect opening hours and staffing, not only illness

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Only register source for hourly temperature and humidity covering both windows; a model reanalysis, not station observations.
suspected_issues: Register default coordinates are 45.46, 9.19 while the brief says the default is Lisbon; the client city is not named in any source, so coordinates must be chosen and recorded in decisions.md
Reanalysis is a model product; humidity may differ from station observations
Register default_query lists temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation only; relative humidity must be requested explicitly
Keep probe ranges to a few days (param_notes)
Terms: https://open-meteo.com/en/licence; licence text not read

candidates.title: AtmosData Pro station-grade weather feed (expired)
candidates.why_relevant: Station-grade weather that could serve production, but it is not usable now.
suspected_issues: Agreement expired: contract AD-2021-114 ran 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31; renewal waiting on Procurement, no signed renewal on file
